diagnosis: Fourfold mobility preserves the validated curvature trajectory but the finite deterministic network approaches a metastable topology above 50 grains. Raising mobility cannot remove a topological arrest because it only rescales time.
corrective_action: Use a 25%-coarsened population (100 parent grains to an exact 75-grain t=0 target) as the stationary pilot and stop its fit before the observed 60-grain finite-network range. Use a larger production network for final inference.
